```python
import re


def test_journey(page, expect, ctx):
    page.goto(ctx.base_url + "/products")
    page.get_by_role("link", name="Ceramic Mug").click()
    expect(page).to_have_url(re.compile(r"/products/2$"))
    expect(page.get_by_role("heading", name="Ceramic Mug")).to_be_visible()
```

match.contains: Send a message through the contact form
match.text:
```python
def test_journey(page, expect, ctx):
    page.goto(ctx.base_url + "/contact")
    page.get_by_label("Name").fill("QA Tester")
    page.get_by_label("Email").fill(ctx.unique_email())
    page.get_by_label("Message").fill("Hello from OneClickQA")
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Send message").click()
    expect(page.get_by_role("heading", level=1)).to_contain_text("Thank you")
```
